input.quote: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Customer Data and Customer pre-existing IP are properly protected (14.1, 15.1), no joint ownership is created (14.4), and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables carries the perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence in 13.2. However, 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of every Deliverable — bespoke work product created and paid for by Customer under 1.4 — with only a revocable, non-transferable licence limited to the Order Form term. That fails both the preferred position (Customer ownership with Vendor assignment) and the fallback, which requires a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables; 13.2's perpetual licence reaches only Vendor Technology, not the Deliverables themselves. Redline reverses the assignment to Customer while expressly preserving Vendor's background IP and Vendor Technology under 14.3.

ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in and to each Deliverable upon its creation. Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property and Vendor Technology in accordance with Section 14.3.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we commission, so we have reversed the assignment in 14.2 to Customer while leaving Vendor's pre-existing IP and Vendor Technology untouched under 14.3. A revocable, term-limited licence to Deliverables we pay for is not something we can accept; if Vendor must retain title, we would need a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Deliverables for our business.
proposal.summary: Reverse Deliverable ownership to Customer with Vendor assignment; Vendor keeps background IP under 14.3.
